name: btn-creative-right

frames.best_why: The pill is fully flooded gold with the white About label and arrow showing, and the cursor is clear of it.

tagline: White pill floods gold on hover, its label slides and an arrow appears.
summary: A pill-shaped link button that starts white with a black dot and the word About. On hover the dot grows into a solid gold fill, the label slides across and a right arrow joins it.
appearance: A white rounded pill with a small black dot near its left end and the word About in bold black, standing on a dark stage. Hovered, the same pill becomes olive-gold with white About text and a white right arrow sitting side by side.
behaviour: Hovering swells the little black dot until it fills the pill in gold while the first label slides right and fades. A matching white label and arrow slide in from the right, and moving away reverses the whole sequence.
search_phrases: pill button that fills on hover
white pill turns gold on hover
button label slides and arrow appears
use_when: A secondary About or link button should feel playful without taking up much room.
avoid_when: The label and gold fill are hardcoded, and the hover-only reveal leaves touch users without a second state.
customise: The label, dot size, fill colours and timing are written into the markup; it takes no props, so every change is a file edit.
weight_why: One pill, one arrow icon and a handful of CSS transitions.

a11y.note: It is a plain div with cursor-pointer, so it cannot be tabbed to, activated from the keyboard, or announced as a button.

issues: The control is a div, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot activate it.
Frames 2 and 5 catch dark text over a half-filled pill, briefly low in contrast.
polish_why: Crisp pill and a satisfying fill-and-arrow reveal; both resting and hover states look finished.
